# Computer Science Club at Pitt

> The Computer Science Club at Pitt (Pitt CSC) is the largest student organization at the University of Pittsburgh and a partner of the School of Computing and Information. Open to all majors.

Also known as: CSC at Pitt, Pitt CSC, Pitt Computer Science Club.

## Quick Facts

- Location: Pittsburgh, PA (University of Pittsburgh)
- Affiliation: Student organization at the University of Pittsburgh; partner of the School of Computing and Information
- Membership: Open to all majors. Meetings are typically held Mondays and Thursdays at 8pm.
- Scale (note on site figures): The Sponsors page and 2026-2027 sponsorship package report 1000+ active members, 75+ events/year, 15K social followers, 100M+ total reel views, and 750K average views per video. The About page currently displays 750+ members and 70+ events (pending e-board confirmation).
- Flagship hackathon: SteelHacks (https://steelhacks.org), Pitt's annual hackathon hosted by Pitt CSC in partnership with the School of Computing and Information.
- Initiatives: Zero to Offer, Foundry, Mock Interviews, Industry Recruiting Events, Site Visits, Launchpad, Dev Lab, Consulting, CSC Hacks, SteelHacks, Bit/Byte, Fireside Chats, Social Events, Social Media.
- Current sponsors on /sponsors/: BNY, CGI, Roblox, Naval Nuclear Lab, Stevens Capital Management, Aerotech, FAST Enterprises, Wesco.
- Contact: pittcsc@gmail.com

## Public Pages

- [Home](https://pittcsc.org/): Club overview, mission, social channels, and Google Calendar.
- [About Us](https://pittcsc.org/about/): Club mission, member/event overview, current officers, and initiative leads.
- [Initiatives](https://pittcsc.org/initiatives/): Career, project team, hackathon, mentorship, speaker, and social programs.
- [Join the Club](https://pittcsc.org/join/): Email list, Google Calendar, community links, and meeting schedule.
- [Sponsors & Partnerships](https://pittcsc.org/sponsors/): Current sponsors, at-a-glance reach, annual tiers, social add-ons, and giving instructions.
- [2026-2027 Sponsorship Package (PDF)](https://pittcsc.org/Pitt_CSC_Sponsorship_Package_2026-2027.pdf): Downloadable partnership overview and tier details.
